body:
In a Rust project, `extract` and `merge` are always refused with `E6013 this Rust project has no code held as symbols to extract`. The cause is in `crate.run_inner`: both are listed in `GLEAM`, and the Rust branch only lets `check`, `test`, `submit`, `delete`, `probe` and the reads through, so `extract`/`merge` fall to `lockdown::plain`. The Rust extract and merge work (D-185, D-205..D-207) was tested by calling the store directly, so nothing caught this. Found in run 1eb9fa406ebb94eb of task:ea673350c54b241e, whose worker had to move code by hand with `submit` and `delete`.

### Change
- Let `extract` and `merge` through the Rust branch of `run_inner`, needing cargo the way `submit` does.

### Done when
- A test runs `extract` and `merge` through the command path (not the store directly) in a Rust project and they succeed.
- `test --all --project solace-cli` passes.
title: extract: Rust extract and merge reachable from the CLI
